title: The Living Chemistry of Coffee
paras: On a hillside coffee farm, freshly picked fruits enter a tank before their seeds become a familiar [[beverage|beverage]]. During the next day, a natural process can influence the price of the harvest. Fermentation is [[essentially|essentially]] the breakdown of sugars by microorganisms, and its effects help explain why coffee from neighbouring farms can taste surprisingly different.

Yeasts and bacteria feed on the sticky fruit layer surrounding each seed. They produce acids and other substances, some of which influence flavours that develop during roasting. Through [[evolution|evolution]], these organisms have acquired different ways of using available nutrients. Temperature and oxygen determine which organisms multiply fastest, so even a cool night can alter the final result.

Farmer Amara and her brother [[inspect|inspect]] the tanks each morning, checking temperature and smell. They [[supervise|supervise]] the workers who wash the seeds when fermentation has progressed far enough. A [[verbal|verbal]] instruction to empty a tank may sound ordinary, but timing matters: excessive fermentation can cause the [[destruction|destruction]] of desirable flavour qualities. The seeds remain, yet their commercial value may fall sharply.

For Amara, understanding microbes is therefore closely connected with farm [[finance|finance]]. Better flavour may attract higher offers, although careful processing cannot guarantee a profitable sale. When a buyer praises a trial batch, she begins to [[grin|grin]]. Her [[emotion|emotion]] reflects more than pride in a pleasant drink: an invisible biological process has helped turn a year's labour into a potentially more valuable harvest.
zh: 在一座山坡上的咖啡农场，新采摘的咖啡果会先进入发酵罐，之后其中的种子才会成为人们熟悉的饮料。在接下来的一天里，一种自然过程可能影响这批收成的售价。发酵本质上是微生物分解糖的过程，它所产生的影响有助于解释：为什么相邻农场出产的咖啡，味道也会有明显差异。
酵母菌和细菌以包裹每颗种子的黏稠果肉层为食。它们产生酸和其他物质，其中一些会影响烘焙过程中形成的风味。经过进化，这些微生物形成了利用现有营养物质的不同方式。温度和氧气决定了哪些微生物繁殖得最快，因此，即使一个凉爽的夜晚也可能改变最终结果。
农场主阿玛拉和她的兄弟每天早晨都会仔细检查发酵罐，测量温度并闻一闻气味。当发酵达到适当程度时，他们会监督工人清洗种子。让工人清空某个罐子的口头指令听起来或许很平常，但时机至关重要：过度发酵可能毁掉原本理想的风味特征。种子虽然还在，商业价值却可能大幅下降。
因此，对阿玛拉而言，了解微生物与农场的资金管理密切相关。更好的风味可能吸引更高的报价，尽管精心加工并不能保证销售获利。当一位买家称赞一批试制咖啡时，她露齿而笑。这份喜悦不只是源于做出美味饮品的自豪：一种看不见的生物过程，帮助她将一年的劳动转化为可能更有价值的收成。

q.s: Differences in overnight temperature can affect the outcome of coffee fermentation.

q.s: Excessive fermentation leaves the market value of coffee seeds unchanged.
q.why: 第三段指出过度发酵可能使商业价值骤降。

q.s: The buyer paid Amara twice the usual price for her trial batch.
